en: Illustrated devotional postcard showing a Catholic church in a hilly landscape at the bottom, with cypress trees and simple surrounding buildings. Above the church, on clouds, is a crowned Madonna holding the infant Jesus, flanked by two angels holding tall candles and a smaller angel head beneath. The style is soft, pastel-colored religious art; no visible printed text appears on the front.
